headline: Aptar Pharma Acquires Pulmotree to Expand Inhaler Portfolio
summary: Aptar Pharma has acquired Pulmotree to broaden its portfolio of drug delivery and inhaler technologies.
why: AptarGroup, Inc. is a global leader in drug delivery, consumer product dispensing, and active packaging solutions.

impacts.name: AptarGroup
impacts.why: Acquiring Pulmotree enhances Aptar's proprietary pharmaceutical delivery capabilities in pulmonary applications.
